<!--
Target tracking dashboard for a national digital transformation programme.
Data come from several CRM exports (organizations, applications, services,
activated services, project dates) and are compared with the programme targets,
nationally and for each of the six territorial areas.

Anonymized and generalized version of a dashboard used in production:
measures, areas, statuses and column names are generic, and target values are
placeholders. Data are not included for confidentiality reasons.
-->

```{r basics}
# reference date: services activated before this date belong to the baseline
baseline_date <- make_date(year = 2021, month = 4, day = 1)

# colours

                 "Technical check failed" = "#080200",
                 "Contract extended for long" = "#232323",

                 "Pre-funding" = "#cc0000",

                 "First technical check" = "#ff8308",

                 "Further technical check" = "#ffab56",

fill_alpha <- c("Needs review (data issue)" = 0.3,
                "Technical check failed" = 0.3,
                "Contract extended for long" = 0.3,
                "Currently rejected" = 1,
                "Pre-funding" = 0.3,

                "Completing" = 1,
                "First technical check" = 1,

                   "Schools" = "#f39c12",
                   "Health authorities" = "#2ecc71",

# application statuses
active_statuses <- c("FUNDED", "UNDER REVIEW", "ACCEPTED", "ADMITTED", "ADMITTED WITH RESERVATION")

inactive_statuses <- c("DRAFT", "PRE-DRAFT", "EXPIRED", "RENOUNCED",
                       "CANCELLED", "WITHDRAWN", "NOT ACCEPTED", "NOT ADMITTED", "CLOSED")

# Call X = call for Measure H projects (see chunk "measure a")
```

```{r read datasets}

# legally active organizations and list of their codes. Local offices of
# national agencies are not included: they are already excluded in the CRM report

active_orgs <- read_excel("./../input/organizations.xlsx") %>%
  filter(`Legal status` != "Dissolved") %>%
  filter(`In public registry` == "Present") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(`Org name`, "DISSOLVED"))

active_org_codes <- pull(active_orgs, `Org code`)


# live applications (active status, submitted by legally active organizations)

live_applications <- read_csv2("./../input/applications.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  filter(Status %in% active_statuses) %>%
  filter(`Applicant: Org code` %in% active_org_codes)

# note: this last filter also removes about a hundred applications from active
# organizations: they are local offices of national agencies, which are not in
# the organizations table


# rejected applications

rejected_applications <- read_csv2("./../input/rejected.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  distinct(`Application ID`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pull(`Application ID`)


# applications at risk: contract still to be signed after many extension days

risky_applications <- live_applications %>%
  filter(`Contracting status` == "To be completed") %>%
  filter(`Total extension days granted` > 180) %>%
  pull(`Application ID`)


# services requested in live applications of legally active organizations

applied_services <- read_csv2("./../input/applied_services.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  filter(Status %in% active_statuses) %>%
  filter(`Org code` %in% active_org_codes)

applications_from_services <- applied_services %>%
  distinct(`Application ID`)
applications_without_services <- anti_join(live_applications, applications_from_services, by = "Application ID")


# Channel E services activated according to the agreed activation rule.
# Activation date conventionally equal to the date of the first notification

activated_services_e <- read_csv2("./../input/activated_services.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  filter(Platform == "E") %>%
  filter(`Service code` != "NULL") %>%
  filter(`Deleted on platform` == 0) %>%
  mutate(`Service name` = str_to_upper(`Service description`)) %>%
  mutate(`Activation date` = case_when(
    `Integration type` == "NONE" & !is.na(`Cost API call date`) & !is.na(`Payment integration date`) ~ "999",
    `Integration type` == "SYNC" & (is.na(`Cost API call date`) | is.na(`Payment integration date`)) ~ "999",
    `Integration type` == "SYNC" & !is.na(`First notification date`) & !is.na(`Cost API call date`) & !is.na(`Interoperability integration date`) & !is.na(`Payment integration date`) ~ `First notification date`,
    `Integration type` == "NONE" & !is.na(`First notification date`) & is.na(`Cost API call date`) & !is.na(`Interoperability integration date`) & is.na(`Payment integration date`) ~ `First notification date`,
    `Integration type` == "ASYNC" & !is.na(`First notification date`) & !is.na(`Interoperability integration date`) ~ `First notification date`,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Activation date`) & `Activation date` != "999") %>%
  mutate(`Activation date` = str_sub(`Activation date`, end = -8)) %>%
  filter(`Org: Org code` %in% active_org_codes)

# services actually activated, i.e.:
# with an activation date
# not deleted afterwards on the platform
# with a valid service code (not NULL)
# for channel E, the rule of the previous block applies

activated_services <- read_csv2("./../input/activated_services.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  filter(`Service code` != "NULL") %>%
  filter(`Deleted on platform` == 0) %>%
  filter(Platform != "E") %>%
  bind_rows(activated_services_e) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Activation date`)) %>%
  mutate(`Activation date` = dmy(`Activation date`),
         `Service description` = str_to_upper(`Service description`)) %>%
  mutate(service_period = if_else(`Activation date` < baseline_date, "pre", "post")) %>%
  filter(`Org: Org code` %in% active_org_codes)

```

```{r functions}
# territorial areas: name used in the code = value in the data
areas <- c(area_a = "AREA_A",
           area_b = "AREA_B",
           area_c = "AREA_C",
           area_d = "AREA_D",
           area_e = "AREA_E",
           area_f = "AREA_F")


# Counts the organizations of a target population, nationally ("all") and by
# area, and checks that the areas add up to the national total.
count_population <- function(population, label) {
  n <- c(all    = nrow(population),
         area_a = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_A")),
         area_b = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_B")),
         area_c = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_C")),
         area_d = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_D")),
         area_e = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_E")),
         area_f = nrow(filter(population, Area == "AREA_F")))

  # population test
  if (sum(n[-1]) == n[["all"]]) {
    print(str_c("Test population ", label, " OK"))
  } else {
    stop(str_c("Area populations ", label, " differ from total population"))
  }

  return(n)
}


# Splits a national target among areas, in proportion to each area's share of
# the target population, and checks that the area targets add up to the
# national one (tolerance of 2 units for rounding).
# Returns a named vector: all, area_a, ..., area_f.
split_target <- function(target_all, n_population, label) {
  targets <- round(target_all * (n_population / n_population[["all"]]), digits = 0)

  # target test
  if (abs(sum(targets[-1]) - target_all) <= 2) {
    print(str_c("Test target ", label, " OK"))
  } else {
    stop(str_c("Area targets ", label, " differ from total target"))
  }

  return(targets)
}


# Bar chart of a measure compared with its targets, for the whole country
# (area = "all") or for one area.
#   data:         one row per application / organization / service to count
#   x_col:        name of the column used as the single bar
#   targets:      named list of target vectors, e.g. list("Q3 2024" = target_a_Q3_24)
#   area_col:     name of the column holding the area in this dataset
#   fill_col:     column used to colour the bar (NULL = plain green bar)
#   fill_values / alpha_values: manual colour and transparency scales
# .data[[...]] lets ggplot use a column whose name is stored in a variable.
plot_progress <- function(data, x_col, targets, area = "all", area_col = "Applicant: Area",
                          y_label = "Applications", fill_col = NULL,
                          fill_values = NULL, alpha_values = NULL,
                          offset_all = 300, offset_area = 100) {

  if (area != "all") {
    data <- data %>% filter(.data[[area_col]] == areas[[area]])
  }

  offset <- if (area == "all") offset_all else offset_area

  if (is.null(fill_col)) {
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]])) +
      geom_bar(fill = "#00cc66")
  } else if (is.null(alpha_values)) {
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], fill = .data[[fill_col]])) +
      geom_bar() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values)
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], fill = .data[[fill_col]], alpha = .data[[fill_col]])) +
      geom_bar() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_values)
  }

  # one horizontal line (with its label) for each target
  for (label in names(targets)) {
    value <- targets[[label]][[area]]
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(yintercept = value) +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = (value + offset), label = label)
  }

  p +
    theme_tracker(angle = 0) +
    ylab(y_label)
}


# Average number of services per organization, by organization type, compared
# with the target average; for the whole country or for one area.
service_averages <- function(services, area = "all") {

  if (area != "all") {
    services <- services %>% filter(`Org: Area` == areas[[area]])
  }

  services %>%
    group_by(`Org type (m)`) %>%
    summarise(Organizations = n_distinct(`Org: Org code`),
              Services = n(),
              `Average services` = round(Services/Organizations, digits = 2)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(`Org type (m)` = fct_relevel(`Org type (m)`, c("Cities", "Schools", "Health authorities", "Regional bodies", "OTHER"))) %>%
    mutate(`Target average` = case_when(
      `Org type (m)` == "Cities" ~ 20,
      `Org type (m)` == "Schools" ~ 6,
      `Org type (m)` == "Health authorities" ~ 10,
      `Org type (m)` == "Regional bodies" ~ 10,
      `Org type (m)` == "OTHER" ~ NA_integer_)) %>%
    arrange(`Org type (m)`) %>%
    rename(`Organization type` = `Org type (m)`)
}
```


```{r targets, include=FALSE}
# NOTE: all target values below are placeholders, not the real programme targets

## Measure A

n_population_a <- active_orgs %>%
  filter(`Org type` == "Cities" | `Org type` == "Schools" | `Org type` == "Health authorities" | `Org type` == "Provinces") %>%
  count_population("A")

target_a_Q3_24 <- split_target(3200, n_population_a, "A Q3 '24")
target_a_Q2_26 <- split_target(7800, n_population_a, "A Q2 '26")


## Measure B (target = share of the target population)

n_population_b <- active_orgs %>%
  filter(`Org type` == "Cities" | `Org type` == "Schools") %>%
  count_population("B")

target_b_Q4_24 <- split_target(round(n_population_b[["all"]]*0.35, digits = 0), n_population_b, "B Q4 '24")
target_b_Q2_26 <- split_target(round(n_population_b[["all"]]*0.75, digits = 0), n_population_b, "B Q2 '26")


## Measure C (same target population for both channels)

n_population_c <- active_orgs %>%
  filter(`Org type` == "Cities" | `Org type` == "Schools" | `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" |
           `Org type` == "Health authorities" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" | `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces") %>%
  count_population("C")

target_c1_orgs_Q4_23 <- split_target(4800, n_population_c, "C1 organizations Q4 '23")
target_c1_orgs_Q2_26 <- split_target(9500, n_population_c, "C1 organizations Q2 '26")
target_c1_services_Q4_23 <- split_target(12000, n_population_c, "C1 services Q4 '23")

target_c2_orgs_Q4_23 <- split_target(9000, n_population_c, "C2 organizations Q4 '23")
target_c2_orgs_Q2_26 <- split_target(12000, n_population_c, "C2 organizations Q2 '26")
target_c2_services_Q4_23 <- split_target(250000, n_population_c, "C2 services Q4 '23")


## Measure D

n_population_d <- active_orgs %>%
  count_population("D")

target_d_Q1_26 <- split_target(7200, n_population_d, "D Q1 '26")


## Measure E

n_population_e <- active_orgs %>%
  filter(`Org type` == "Cities" | `Org type` == "National agencies") %>%
  count_population("E")

target_e_Q4_23 <- split_target(600, n_population_e, "E Q4 '23")
target_e_Q2_26 <- split_target(5000, n_population_e, "E Q2 '26")


## Measure F

n_population_f <- active_orgs %>%
  filter(`Org type` == "Cities" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" | `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces" | `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" | `Org type` == "Health authorities") %>%
  count_population("F")

target_f_Q4_24 <- split_target(350, n_population_f, "F Q4 '24")
target_f_Q2_26 <- split_target(900, n_population_f, "F Q2 '26")


# targets shown in each chart (label = text next to the line)
targets_a <- list("Q3 2024" = target_a_Q3_24, "Q2 2026" = target_a_Q2_26)
targets_b <- list("Q4 2024" = target_b_Q4_24, "Q2 2026" = target_b_Q2_26)
targets_c1 <- list("Q4 2023" = target_c1_orgs_Q4_23, "Q2 2026" = target_c1_orgs_Q2_26)
targets_c2 <- list("Q4 2023" = target_c2_orgs_Q4_23, "Q2 2026" = target_c2_orgs_Q2_26)
targets_d <- list("Q1 2026" = target_d_Q1_26)
targets_e <- list("Q4 2023" = target_e_Q4_23, "Q2 2026" = target_e_Q2_26)
targets_f <- list("Q4 2024" = target_f_Q4_24, "Q2 2026" = target_f_Q2_26)
```

```{r measure a}
# count of Measure A + multi-measure applications with no services to migrate
# to the hub, based on the service "Destination"
# the number must match the applications found with "awarded amount (parent 1)"

# organizations with a Measure H application: they are removed from Measure A
# at the end, since the two measures cannot be counted twice

orgs_h <- live_applications %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure H")) %>%
  distinct(`Applicant: Org code`) %>%
  pull(`Applicant: Org code`)

applications_a_pre <- applied_services %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure A") |
           str_detect(`Call title`, "Measures H and A")) %>%
  count(`Application ID`, Measure, Destination) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    Measure == "Measure A" ~ 0,
    Destination == "Hub" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  group_by(`Application ID`, Measure) %>%
  summarise(sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(`sum(value)` == 0) %>%
  left_join(live_applications[,c("Application ID", "Applicant: Org code", "Status", "Project status", "Last technical check result", "Contracting status", "Applicant: Area", "Applicant: Org type")], by = "Application ID") %>%
  mutate(`Progress status` = case_when(
    `Application ID` %in% rejected_applications ~ "Currently rejected",
    `Application ID` %in% risky_applications ~ "Contract extended for long",
    Status == "UNDER REVIEW" | Status == "ADMITTED" | Status == "ACCEPTED" ~ "Pre-funding",
    `Contracting status` == "To be completed" ~ "Contracting",
    `Project status` == "STARTED" & is.na(`Last technical check result`) ~ "Completing",
    `Project status` == "STARTED" & `Last technical check result` == "Partial" ~ "Partial",
    `Project status` == "UNDER REVIEW" & is.na(`Last technical check result`) ~ "First technical check",
    `Project status` == "UNDER REVIEW" & `Last technical check result` == "Partial" ~ "Further technical check",
    `Last technical check result` == "Positive" ~ "Technical check passed",
    `Last technical check result` == "Negative" ~ "Technical check failed",
    TRUE ~ "Needs review (data issue)")) %>%
  mutate(`Progress status` = fct_relevel(`Progress status`, "Needs review (data issue)", "Currently rejected", "Technical check failed", "Contract extended for long", "Pre-funding", "Contracting", "Completing", "First technical check", "Partial", "Further technical check", "Technical check passed")) %>%
  mutate(`Measure A` = "Measure A") %>%
  arrange(desc(`Progress status`))

applications_a_distinct <- applications_a_pre %>%
  distinct(`Applicant: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE)

applications_a <- applications_a_distinct %>%
  filter(!`Applicant: Org code` %in% orgs_h)


applications_a_zero_award <- live_applications %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure A") |
           str_detect(`Call title`, "Measures H and A") & `Awarded amount (parent 1)` == 0)


# applications classified differently by the two methods: exported for checking
contradictory_applications <- anti_join(applications_a_pre, applications_a_zero_award, by = "Application ID") %>%
  left_join(live_applications[,c("Application ID", "Call title", "Awarded amount (parent 1)", "Phase")], by = "Application ID") %>%
  rename(`Hub service present` = `sum(value)`)
write.xlsx(contradictory_applications, str_c("./output/ambiguous_applications.xlsx"))

projects_removed_h <- nrow(applications_a_distinct) - nrow(applications_a)
```


```{r measure b}

applications_b <- live_applications %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure B")) %>%
  mutate(`Progress status` = case_when(
    `Application ID` %in% rejected_applications ~ "Currently rejected",
    `Application ID` %in% risky_applications ~ "Contract extended for long",
    Status == "UNDER REVIEW" | Status == "ADMITTED" | Status == "ACCEPTED" ~ "Pre-funding",
    `Contracting status` == "To be completed" ~ "Contracting",
    `Project status` == "STARTED" & is.na(`Last technical check result`) ~ "Completing",
    `Project status` == "STARTED" & `Last technical check result` == "Partial" ~ "Partial",
    `Project status` == "UNDER REVIEW" & is.na(`Last technical check result`) ~ "First technical check",
    `Project status` == "UNDER REVIEW" & `Last technical check result` == "Partial" ~ "Further technical check",
    `Last technical check result` == "Positive" ~ "Technical check passed",
    `Last technical check result` == "Negative" ~ "Technical check failed",
    TRUE ~ "Needs review (data issue)")) %>%
  mutate(`Progress status` = fct_relevel(`Progress status`, "Needs review (data issue)", "Currently rejected", "Technical check failed", "Contract extended for long", "Pre-funding", "Contracting", "Completing", "First technical check", "Partial", "Further technical check", "Technical check passed")) %>%
  mutate(`Measure B` = "Measure B") %>%
  arrange(desc(`Progress status`)) %>%
  distinct(`Applicant: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r measure c1}

# organization target

# codes of organizations with at least one funded Channel 1 application
funded_codes_c1 <- live_applications %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 1")) %>%
  filter(Status == "FUNDED") %>%
  mutate(`Funded C1 application` = "YES") %>%
  select(`Org: Org code` = `Applicant: Org code`, `Funded C1 application`) %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE)

# all Measure C organizations, split into baseline (pre) and new (post, i.e. with post-baseline services only)
orgs_period_c1 <- activated_services %>%
  filter(Platform == "C1") %>%
  arrange(service_period) %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename(period = service_period) %>%
  select(-`Service code`, -`Active service: Name`, -`Service description`, -`Deleted on platform`)

# eligible organizations
eligible_orgs_c1 <- orgs_period_c1 %>%
  mutate(`Measure C` = "Channel 1") %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = c("Org: Org code" = "Org code")) %>%
  left_join(funded_codes_c1, by = "Org: Org code") %>%
  mutate(Eligible = case_when(
    period == "pre" ~ "YES",
    `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "YES",
    `Org type` != "Schools" & `Funded C1 application` == "YES" ~ "YES",
    TRUE ~ "NO")) %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Org: Region`, Platform, period, `Measure C`, `Org type`, `Funded C1 application`, Eligible, `Org: Area`) %>%
  filter(Eligible == "YES")

n_eligible_c1 <- round(nrow(eligible_orgs_c1), digits = 0)
n_baseline_c1 <- round(nrow(eligible_orgs_c1 %>% filter(period == "pre")), digits = 0)


# average targets

# services activated by eligible organizations, only for organizations in the target population
eligible_services_c1 <- activated_services %>%
  filter(Platform == "C1") %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Service code`, `Service description`, Platform, `Org: Area`) %>%
  left_join(eligible_orgs_c1[,c("Org: Org code", "Eligible")], by = "Org: Org code") %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = c("Org: Org code" = "Org code")) %>%
  mutate(`Org type (m)` = case_when(
    `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" | `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "Schools",
    `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" ~ "Regional bodies",
    `Org type` == "Veterinary institutes" | `Org type` == "Public care agencies" | `Org type` == "Other bodies" ~ "OTHER",
    `Org type` == "Cities" ~ "Cities",
    `Org type` == "Health authorities" ~ "Health authorities",
    TRUE ~ "ALERT")) %>%
  filter(!`Org: Org code` %in% excluded_orgs) %>%
  filter(Eligible == "YES")


# potential services (applied for but not yet activated: we want to count them too)
# they necessarily belong to baseline or new eligible organizations (with a funded application)
# they necessarily belong to organizations in the target population
# they are split into the four categories, removing those already activated

potential_services_c1 <- applied_services %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 1")) %>%
  mutate(`Service description` = str_to_upper(`Requested service name`)) %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = "Org code") %>%
  mutate(`Org type (m)` = case_when(
    `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" | `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "Schools",
    `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" ~ "Regional bodies",
    `Org type` == "Veterinary institutes" | `Org type` == "Public care agencies" | `Org type` == "Other bodies" ~ "OTHER",
    `Org type` == "Cities" ~ "Cities",
    `Org type` == "Health authorities" ~ "Health authorities",
    TRUE ~ "ALERT")) %>%
  filter(!`Org code` %in% excluded_orgs) %>%
  anti_join(activated_services, by = c("Org code" = "Org: Org code", "Service code")) %>%
  anti_join(activated_services, by = c("Org code" = "Org: Org code", "Service description")) %>%
  filter(is.na(`Service code`)) %>%
  rename(`Org: Org name` = `Org name`, `Org: Org code` = `Org code`, `Org: Area` = Area) %>%
  mutate(Platform = "C1",
         Eligible = "potential") %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Service code`, `Service description`, Platform, `Org: Area`, Eligible, `Org type`, `Org type (m)`) %>%
  bind_rows(eligible_services_c1)
```

```{r measure c2}

# organization target

# codes of organizations with at least one funded Channel 2 application
funded_codes_c2 <- live_applications %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 2")) %>%
  filter(Status == "FUNDED") %>%
  mutate(`Funded C2 application` = "YES") %>%
  select(`Org: Org code` = `Applicant: Org code`, `Funded C2 application`) %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE)

# all Measure C organizations, split into baseline (pre) and new (post, i.e. with post-baseline services only)
orgs_period_c2 <- activated_services %>%
  filter(Platform == "C2") %>%
  arrange(service_period) %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename(period = service_period) %>%
  select(-`Service code`, -`Active service: Name`, -`Service description`, -`Deleted on platform`)

# eligible organizations
eligible_orgs_c2 <- orgs_period_c2 %>%
  mutate(`Measure C` = "Channel 2") %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = c("Org: Org code" = "Org code")) %>%
  left_join(funded_codes_c2, by = "Org: Org code") %>%
  mutate(Eligible = case_when(
    period == "pre" ~ "YES",
    `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "YES",
    `Org type` != "Schools" & `Funded C2 application` == "YES" ~ "YES",
    TRUE ~ "NO")) %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Org: Region`, Platform, period, `Measure C`, `Org type`, `Funded C2 application`, Eligible, `Org: Area`) %>%
  filter(Eligible == "YES")

n_eligible_c2 <- round(nrow(eligible_orgs_c2), digits = 0)
n_baseline_c2 <- round(nrow(eligible_orgs_c2 %>% filter(period == "pre")), digits = 0)


# average targets

# services activated by eligible organizations, only for organizations in the target population
eligible_services_c2 <- activated_services %>%
  filter(Platform == "C2") %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Service code`, `Service description`, Platform, `Org: Area`) %>%
  left_join(eligible_orgs_c2[,c("Org: Org code", "Eligible")], by = "Org: Org code") %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = c("Org: Org code" = "Org code")) %>%
  mutate(`Org type (m)` = case_when(
    `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" | `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "Schools",
    `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" ~ "Regional bodies",
    `Org type` == "Veterinary institutes" | `Org type` == "Public care agencies" | `Org type` == "Other bodies" ~ "OTHER",
    `Org type` == "Cities" ~ "Cities",
    `Org type` == "Health authorities" ~ "Health authorities",
    TRUE ~ "ALERT")) %>%
  filter(!`Org: Org code` %in% excluded_orgs) %>%
  filter(Eligible == "YES")


# potential services (applied for but not yet activated: we want to count them too)
# they necessarily belong to baseline or new eligible organizations (with a funded application)
# they necessarily belong to organizations in the target population
# they are split into the four categories, removing those already activated

potential_services_c2 <- applied_services %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 2")) %>%
  mutate(`Service description` = str_to_upper(`Requested service name`)) %>%
  left_join(active_orgs[,c("Org code", "Org type")], by = "Org code") %>%
  mutate(`Org type (m)` = case_when(
    `Org type` == "Universities" | `Org type` == "Research institutes" | `Org type` == "Schools" ~ "Schools",
    `Org type` == "Autonomous provinces" | `Org type` == "Regional bodies" ~ "Regional bodies",
    `Org type` == "Veterinary institutes" | `Org type` == "Public care agencies" | `Org type` == "Other bodies" ~ "OTHER",
    `Org type` == "Cities" ~ "Cities",
    `Org type` == "Health authorities" ~ "Health authorities",
    TRUE ~ "ALERT")) %>%
  filter(!`Org code` %in% excluded_orgs) %>%
  anti_join(activated_services, by = c("Org code" = "Org: Org code", "Taxonomy code" = "Service code")) %>%
  rename(`Org: Org name` = `Org name`, `Org: Org code` = `Org code`, `Org: Area` = Area) %>%
  mutate(Platform = "C2",
         Eligible = "potential") %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Service code`, `Service description`, Platform, `Org: Area`, Eligible, `Org type`, `Org type (m)`) %>%
  bind_rows(eligible_services_c2)
```


```{r measure d}
activated_d <- active_orgs %>%
  mutate(Activations = case_when(
    `Digital ID method 1` == TRUE & `Digital ID method 2` == TRUE ~ "Both methods",
    `Digital ID method 1` == TRUE & `Digital ID method 2` == FALSE ~ "Method 1 only",
    `Digital ID method 1` == FALSE & `Digital ID method 2` == TRUE ~ "Method 2 only",
    TRUE ~ "KO")) %>%
  filter(Activations == "Both methods" | Activations == "Method 1 only" | Activations == "Method 2 only") %>%
```

```{r measure e}
funded_e <- live_applications %>%

         `Funded E application`) %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE)

activated_e <- activated_services %>%
  filter(Platform == "E") %>%
  distinct(`Org: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(`Measure E` = "Channel E") %>%
  left_join(funded_e, by = "Org: Org code") %>%
  rename(Eligible = `Funded E application`) %>%
  select(`Org: Org name`, `Org: Org code`, `Org: Area`, `Measure E`, Eligible) %>%
  filter(Eligible == "YES")

# organizations that (1) applied but are not funded yet or (2) are funded but have not activated yet

  filter(str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure E")) %>%
  anti_join(activated_e, by = c("Applicant: Org code" = "Org: Org code")) %>%
  distinct(`Applicant: Org code`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(`Measure E` = "Channel E", Eligible = "Potential") %>%
  select(`Org: Org name` = `Applicant: Org name`,
         `Org: Org code` = `Applicant: Org code`,

orgs_e <- bind_rows(activated_e, potential_e)

e_colors <- c("YES" = "#00cc66", "Potential" = "#00cc66")
e_alpha <- c("YES" = 1, "Potential" = 0.3)
```

```{r progress}
project_dates <- read_csv2("./../input/project_dates.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) %>%
  mutate(`Funding decree date` = dmy(`Funding decree date`),
         `Contracting deadline` = dmy(`Contracting deadline`),
         `Contracting date` = dmy(`Contracting date`),
         `Planned completion date` = dmy(`Planned completion date`),
         `Activity completion deadline` = dmy(`Activity completion deadline`),
         `Activity completion date` = dmy_hm(`Activity completion date`),
         `Positive technical check date` = dmy_hm(`Positive technical check date`),
         `Payment processing date` = dmy_hm(`Payment processing date`),
         `Paid date` = dmy_hm(`Paid date`),
         `Closing date` = dmy(`Closing date`),
         download_date = today()) %>%
  mutate(`Activity completion date` = floor_date(`Activity completion date`, unit = "day"),
         `Positive technical check date` = floor_date(`Positive technical check date`, unit = "day"),
         `Payment processing date` = floor_date(`Payment processing date`, unit = "day"),
         `Paid date` = floor_date(`Paid date`, unit = "day")) %>%
  mutate(Measure = case_when(
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measures H and A") ~ "Multi-measure",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure A") ~ "A",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure B") ~ "B",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 2") ~ "C2",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure C - Channel 1") ~ "C1",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure D - Digital ID") ~ "D ID",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure D - Civil registry") ~ "D Registry",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure E") ~ "E",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure F") & !str_detect(`Call title`, "Address registry") ~ "F Interop",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure F") & str_detect(`Call title`, "Address registry") ~ "F Address",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "Measure H") ~ "H",
    TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  filter(Measure != "Other") %>%
  mutate(Measure = fct_relevel(Measure, c("A", "B", "C1", "C2", "D ID", "D Registry", "E", "F Interop", "F Address", "Multi-measure", "H"))) %>%
  mutate(Population = case_when(
    Measure == "E" ~ "Cities",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "- Cities") ~ "Cities",
    str_detect(`Call title`, "- Schools") ~ "Schools",
    TRUE ~ "Other bodies")) %>%
  mutate(Population = fct_relevel(Population, c("Cities", "Schools", "Other bodies"))) %>%
  select(Project = `Application ID`,
         Organization = `Applicant: Org name`,
         `Org code`,
         Measure,
         Population,
         Area = `Applicant: Area`,
         Phase,
         download_date,
         funding_decree_date = `Funding decree date`,
         contracting_date = `Contracting date`,
         technical_check_date = `Positive technical check date`,
         payment_processing_date = `Payment processing date`,
         paid_date = `Paid date`)

not_funded <- project_dates %>%
  filter(is.na(funding_decree_date))

# completion

completion <- project_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(funding_decree_date)) %>%
  group_by(funding_decree_date, Measure, Population) %>%
  summarise(`Funded projects` = n(), `Technical check passed` = sum(!is.na(technical_check_date)), Paid = sum(!is.na(paid_date))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(`% Technical check passed` = round((`Technical check passed` / `Funded projects`)*100, digits = 2),
         `% Paid` = round((Paid / `Funded projects`)*100, digits = 2)) %>%
  rename(`Decree of` = funding_decree_date)


# contracting

df_contracting <- project_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(funding_decree_date) & !is.na(contracting_date)) %>%
  select(Measure, Population, Area, funding_decree_date, contracting_date) %>%
  mutate(aging = contracting_date - funding_decree_date) %>%
  filter(aging > 0)

avg_contracting <- df_contracting %>%
  group_by(funding_decree_date, Measure, Population) %>%
  summarise(average = mean(aging)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(average = round(average, digits = 0)) %>%
  rename(`Decree of` = funding_decree_date, `Average contracting time` = average)

plot_contracting <- ggplot(avg_contracting) +
  geom_col(aes(x = `Decree of`, y = `Average contracting time`)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = `Decree of`, y = `Average contracting time`)) +
  theme_tracker(angle = 45) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Measure), cols = vars(Population))


# implementation

df_implementation <- project_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(contracting_date) & !is.na(technical_check_date)) %>%
  mutate(technical_check_date = ymd(technical_check_date)) %>%
  select(Measure, Population, Area, funding_decree_date, contracting_date, technical_check_date) %>%
  mutate(aging = technical_check_date - contracting_date) %>%
  filter(aging > 0)

avg_implementation <- df_implementation %>%
  group_by(funding_decree_date, Measure, Population) %>%
  summarise(average = mean(aging)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(average = round(average, digits = 0)) %>%
  rename(`Decree of` = funding_decree_date, `Average implementation time` = average)

plot_implementation <- ggplot(avg_implementation) +
  geom_col(aes(x = `Decree of`, y = `Average implementation time`)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = `Decree of`, y = `Average implementation time`)) +
  theme_tracker(angle = 45) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Measure), cols = vars(Population))


# assembly

df_aging <- completion %>%
  left_join(avg_contracting, by = c("Decree of", "Measure", "Population")) %>%
  left_join(avg_implementation, by = c("Decree of", "Measure", "Population"))

plot_aging <- ggplot(df_aging %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(`% Technical check passed`, `% Paid`), values_to = "% Progress", names_to = "Progress type")) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Decree of`, y = `% Progress`, color = `Progress type`, size = `Funded projects`)) +
  theme_tracker(angle = 45) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Measure), cols = vars(Population)) +
  labs(color = "Technical checks & payments", size = "Number of projects funded in each window")
```
